summary: Resume governed PR delivery after pre-PR interruption

delivery.outcome: A governed pull-request retry safely resumes an already committed exact-ticket candidate after a pre-PR interruption
nonGoals: No raw push bypass or weakening of the governed delivery hook
No resume from dirty, divergent, unbound, behind or unknown histories
No version, changelog, tag, registry or GitHub Release mutation
No change to direct-main or publish-only retry semantics

architecture.decision: Classify pending committed PR work at the governed delivery boundary, then let the orchestrator rerun tests and call the existing authorized PR delivery function
interfaceChanges: Internal delivery classifier returns immutable pending-PR evidence to the push orchestrator
architecture.rollback: Revert the unmerged ticket branch; interrupted delivery continues to require a new staged evidence commit before Goal can retry

validation.evidence: Only a clean exact-ticket fast-forward range is classified as resumable
The no-files path reruns tests and delegates exact HEAD to governed PR delivery
Unsafe histories do not push and divergence fails closed

commands: ruff check goal/governance/delivery.py goal/push/core.py tests/test_governance_delivery.py tests/test_delivery_integrity.py
validation.evidence: Focused, full, static, governance, package and container checks pass
